teaser.en: The 'forest mango' looks like a mango tree that wandered into the woods, but cut a leaf and white latex appears.
teaser.sw: 'Mwembe wa msituni' unaonekana kama mwembe uliopotea ukaingia porini, lakini ukikata jani, utomvu mweupe hutoka.
teaser.dg: *Mwembe tsaka* unaonekana dza mwembe uriotanga ukainjira tsakani, ela uchikata kodza, maziya mereru ganatuluka.

summary.en: *Mwembe tsaka*, the 'forest mango', is a coastal forest tree whose leaves look like a mango's. It belongs to the milkwood family and bleeds white latex when cut.
summary.sw: *Mwembe tsaka*, yaani 'mwembe wa msituni', ni mti wa misitu ya pwani ambao majani yake yanafanana na ya mwembe. Ni wa familia ya Sapotaceae (familia ya Sapotaceae) na hutoa utomvu mweupe ukikatwa.
summary.dg: *Mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa tsakani', ni muhi wa matsaka ga pwani ambao makodzage ganafanana na ga mwembe. Ni wa jamii ya *Sapotaceae* (milkwood), na uchikatwa unalavya maziya mereru.

about.en: *Mwembe tsaka* is a forest tree with long, glossy leaves much like those of the mango, which is where its Digo name comes from. It is not a mango at all: it belongs to the milkwood family (Sapotaceae), and like its relatives it oozes a white, milky latex when a leaf or the bark is broken. That latex is the quickest way to tell it from a true mango.
about.sw: *Mwembe tsaka* ni mti wa msituni wenye majani marefu yanayong'aa, yanayofanana sana na ya mwembe, na hapo ndipo jina lake la Kidigo linapotoka. Hata hivyo si mwembe hata kidogo: ni wa familia ya Sapotaceae, na kama jamaa zake, hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa jani au gome linapovunjwa. Utomvu huo ndiyo njia ya haraka zaidi ya kuutofautisha na mwembe halisi.
about.dg: *Mwembe tsaka* ni muhi wa tsakani wenye makodza mare ganagong'ala, ganagofanana sana na ga mwembe, na phapho ndipho dzinare ra Chidigo ririphotuluka. Ela si mwembe hata chidide: ni wa jamii ya milkwood (*Sapotaceae*), na dza nduguze, unalavya maziya mereru kodza au gopha richivundzika. Maziya higo ndiyo njira ya upesi zaidi ya kuutafwautisha na mwembe wa kpweli.

culture.en: The name means 'forest mango': *mwembe* is the mango tree and *tsaka* is the bush or forest. It is a good example of how Digo names wild plants by comparing them to familiar ones.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mwembe wa msituni': *mwembe* ni mti wa embe na *tsaka* ni pori au msitu. Ni mfano mzuri wa jinsi Kidigo kinavyoipa mimea ya porini majina kwa kuilinganisha na mimea inayojulikana.
culture.dg: Dzina rinamaanisha 'mwembe wa tsakani': *mwembe* ni muhi wa maembe, na *tsaka* ni weruni au tsaka. Ni mfwano mnono wa ambavyo Adigo nkuiha mimea ya weruni kpwa kuifananisha na mimea ambayo anaimanya.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwembe tsaka*, 'forest mango'. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Inhambanella henriquesii*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa msituni'. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Inhambanella henriquesii*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwembe tsaka*, 'mwembe wa tsakani'. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Inhambanella henriquesii*.

reason.dg: Mwembe, ambao muhi uhu ukaihwa kula kpwakpwe.
